excerpt_i18n.en: On December 12, the eighth GAIR Global Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Summit officially commenced in Shenzhen. The two-day event was jointly organized by the GAIR Research Institute and Leiphone, with Academician Gao Wen serving as the chair of the steering committee, and Academician Yang Qiang and Professor Zhu Xiaorui as the conference chairs. As a benchmark gathering for AI industry, academia, research, and investment, GAIR has consistently upheld the core principle of "heritage + innovation" since its inception in 2016. It serves as a platform for intellectual exchange in the AI academic community, a hub for technical discussions, and a spiritual home for China's four-decade journey in AI development. Over the past four years, large models have accelerated the transformation of the AI industry. As the year draws to a close, GAIR returns as scheduled, fostering high-quality idea exchanges and presenting cutting-edge insights into the AI era for the industry and the public. At this summit, Professor Jia Jiaya, Chair Professor at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, Director of the Von Neumann Institute, and IEEE Fellow, delivered an engaging opening keynote. Professor Jia first reviewed the AI research and achievements led by his team before and after the establishment of the Von Neumann Institute. Among these, several latest technological breakthroughs from this year were publicly disclosed for the first time: 1. In 2023, the LongLoRA technology was released, becoming the world's first large model technology for 32K long-text context understanding; 2. In 2024, Mini-Gemini was launched—this platform has garnered over 3,000 stars on GitHub.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 12 de diciembre, la octava edición de la Conferencia Global de Inteligencia Artificial y Robótica (GAIR) se inauguró oficialmente en Shenzhen. Este evento de dos días está organizado conjuntamente por el Instituto de Investigación GAIR y Leiphone, con el académico Gao Wen como presidente del comité directivo, y los académicos Yang Qiang y la profesora Zhu Xiaorui como copresidentes de la conferencia. Como referente en la integración de la investigación, la industria y la inversión en IA, GAIR, desde su creación en 2016, ha mantenido el núcleo de "herencia + innovación", siendo un espacio para el relevo de ideas en la academia de IA, una plataforma para el intercambio tecnológico y, sobre todo, el hogar espiritual del desarrollo de la IA en China durante cuarenta años. En los últimos cuatro años, los grandes modelos han impulsado una acelerada transformación de la industria de la IA, y GAIR llega puntual a finales de año.

items.title: 郭毅可院士：AI带来「知识通胀」，击碎了传统教育的「前提假设」丨GAIR 2025
items.raw_excerpt: 12月12日， 第八届 GAIR 全球人工智能与机器人大会于深圳正式拉开帷幕。 本次大会为期两天，由GAIR研究院与雷峰网联合主办，高文院士任指导委员会主席，杨强院士与朱晓蕊教授任大会主席。 作为 AI 产学研投界标杆盛会，GAIR自2016年创办以来，始终坚守 “传承+创新” 内核，是 AI 学界思想接力的阵地、技术交流的平台，更是中国 AI 四十年发展的精神家园。过去四年大模型驱动 AI 产业加速变革，岁末年初 GAIR 如约而至，以高质量观点碰撞，为行业与大众呈现AI时代的前沿洞见。 本次峰会之上， 中国工程院外籍院士、英国皇家工程院院士、香港科技大学首席副校长郭毅可校长 亲临现场，为与会者们带来了一场精彩纷呈的开场报告。 深耕学界多年的他，见证了AI与高等教育的演进交汇。他从生成式AI重塑“知识获取方式”谈起，指出当下教育的对象已经不仅是孩子，也包括机器，而两者之间存在着意想不到的共性。借此，他引出了对“教育范式即将转向”的思考： 1、所有的教育，都基于一个基本假设：知识的稀缺性。但今天，大语言模型带来了知识的通货膨胀，本来的黄金变成了空气，教育和学习还有意义吗？ 2、知识是具有共识的认知。而大语言模型是大量互联网信息的压缩，是统计学意义上的共识。 3、学习有两个意义：理解世界（客观建模），理解自己（价值建模）。现在的核心挑战是：机器在客观建模上已经开始超越人类。 4、当前AI在身份建模上能力仍显薄弱。核心问题在于，身份模型具有个性化属性，而强化学习所依赖的反馈却是偏向共性化的，因此，人性与人格的培育或将成为我们后续教育行业发展的关键。 5、人工智能时代的教育，应从“知识传输”，转为培养学生的能力、好奇心、学习主动性和共创意识。 6、不要老是担忧AI会替代我们，而要把自己解放出来。尤其教育者，要对AI保持乐观：如果学生还能用AI作弊，那就说明考试方式本身出了问题。

items.title: 深圳理工大学唐志敏：异构计算已成必然，软件决定芯片胜负 ｜GAIR 2025
items.raw_excerpt: 作者｜包永刚 编辑｜林觉民 2025年12月12-13日，第八届GAIR全球人工智能与机器人大会在深圳·博林天瑞喜来登酒店正式启幕。 作为AI 产学研投界的标杆盛会，GAIR自2016年创办以来，始终坚守“传承+创新”内核，始终致力于连接技术前沿与产业实践。 在人工智能逐步成为国家竞争核心变量的当下，算力正以前所未有的速度重塑技术路径与产业结构。13日举办的「AI 算力新十年」专场聚焦智能体系的底层核心——算力，从架构演进、生态构建到产业化落地展开系统讨论，试图为未来十年的中国AI产业，厘清关键变量与发展方向。 深圳理工大学算力微电子学院院长、龙芯 CPU 与海光 CPU 创始人唐志敏发表了题为《XPU的未来——软件决定成败》的主题演讲。 唐老师指出，算力不仅是硬件性能的体现，更是一种在资源与时间约束下完成任务的能力体系。在这一背景下，训力、推力等新型算力能力正在逐步形成，推动人工智能从语言理解向多模态生成发展。 他强调，随着生成式 AI 对算力需求的快速增长，单靠 CPU 已无法满足现实需求，异构计算（CPU+XPU）成为必然选择。但硬件本身并非决定因素，真正影响算力释放的，是软件与应用生态。他通过对x86、Arm和RISC-V的分析，指出生态惯性和软件兼容性在商业化和技术落地中起到决定性作用，生态成熟度往往比硬件性能更能决定芯片成败。 唐志敏也强调，软件定义一切，这不仅意味着应用开发与性能优化，更决定了算力芯片的长期竞争力和产业格局。 在算力体系演进中，硬件是基础，但软件和生态才是真正的“决定因素”。无论是 CPU、GPU 还是未来的 XPU，掌握和构建完整的软件生态，才能在高速增长的算力需求与复杂的技术挑战中立于不败之地。 以下为唐志敏老师的精彩演讲内容，雷峰网作了不改变原意的整理与编辑： 从“算力”到 Computility：算力正在被重新定义 “算力”其实是中国人

excerpt_i18n.en: With the new generation open-source in-memory database Valkey rapidly maturing in the global community, the landscape of open-source foundational software is undergoing significant changes. On December 23, Tencent Cloud announced it was the first in China to support and release Valkey 8.0, while also ranking first globally in community code contributions, becoming a key force in advancing the project toward production-level applications. Valkey is an open-source in-memory key-value database project hosted by the Linux Foundation and originating from the Redis community, dedicated to building a vendor-neutral, long-term stable foundational software platform through permissive open-source licensing and community governance. Kyle Davis, the open-source lead for Valkey, stated that Valkey has rediscovered the original intent of the open-source community, and the continuous investment from cloud providers like Tencent Cloud has laid a solid foundation for the project's long-term sustainable development. Currently, leading global cloud providers such as AWS, Google Cloud, Oracle, Tencent Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, and Huawei Cloud are deeply involved in the Valkey community co-construction, forming an open-source collaboration model centered on the community. The Valkey China community has also been established in Beijing, with Chinese developers actively participating in global community governance. As one of the founding members of the Valkey community, Tencent Cloud is deeply engaged in project co-construction, continuously feeding back large-scale cloud business practices to the community and contributing significant core code in areas such as cluster scaling, performance optimization, and stability enhancement. Tencent Cloud database expert Zhu Binbin.

Valkey es un proyecto de base de datos en memoria clave-valor de código abierto, alojado por la Fundación Linux y originado en la comunidad Redis, que se dedica a construir una plataforma de software básico neutral para proveedores y estable a largo plazo, bajo un modelo de licencia de código abierto permisiva y gobernanza comunitaria.

For a long time, climate, weather, and Earth system research relied almost entirely on numerical simulations. Supercomputers were tasked with solving physical equations layer by layer, with the precision, resolution, and stability of models determining how much of the natural system humanity could "see." In recent years, as computing power conditions have evolved, artificial intelligence has increasingly been introduced into these traditional fields. Particularly in climate and Earth system modeling, AI is held in high hopes: can it fill in the details that numerical models struggle to cover? Can it provide a finer view of the system under limited computing power? These questions are becoming unavoidable discussions in the fields of supercomputing and scientific computing.

Earth system models represent one of the most typical scenarios in this regard. From global circulation to local weather, from oceans to the atmosphere, and from kilometer-scale to finer variations, the processes these models need to handle are extremely complex and nearly impossible to fully exhaust. Precisely because of this, academia and engineering circles have maintained a cautious, even divided, attitude toward how AI should be integrated into Earth system modeling.

At the GAIR 2025 conference, discussions surrounding the relationship between artificial intelligence and scientific computing were once again brought into focus. Professor Fu Haohuan shared insights during the event, exploring the boundaries and possibilities between numerical simulation and AI in the context of Earth system models and supercomputing practices. excerpt_i18n.en: Cloud providers are now at a critical juncture to break through. After years of fierce competition, the cloud market has become suffocating—trapped in relentless price wars, non-standardized projects, and high-investment business models that are difficult to scale, much like a quagmire. Could large models, repeatedly hyped by the market, be the key for cloud providers to escape this predicament? Many believe so, but the path forward remains unclear. On December 18–19, ByteDance’s Volcano Engine held its 2025 Winter Force conference, showcasing new advancements like the Doubao large model 1.8 and the video generation model Seedance 1.5 pro, aiming to carve a "channel" through the industry’s rigid barriers and bring the "living water" of AI into the sector. It can be said that Agent represents today’s "super consensus" for AI breakthroughs, but how to develop Agents remains a "diverse narrative" with varied opinions among providers. The Agent Infra platform—"AgentKit"—is Volcano’s answer to this major challenge. While there are many Agent developer platforms today, what is the logic behind Volcano’s AgentKit? Clues may already be hidden in the history of Volcano Engine’s development. Volcano’s MaaS topping the charts is largely due to seizing the AI dividend. In 2025, which cloud provider leads in MaaS? The answer is undoubtedly Volcano Engine.

On December 23, the globally authoritative AI benchmark platform Artificial Analysis released its latest image model rankings. Alibaba's 6B-parameter Z-Image Turbo surpassed the 32B FLUX.2 to become the top open-source image generation model. Currently, the model is available on Alibaba Cloud's Bailian platform, costing only $5 to generate 1,000 images.

Z-Image Turbo overtook FLUX.2 to top the Artificial Analysis image model rankings. According to official data from Artificial Analysis, Z-Image Turbo achieved an ELO score of 1152, setting a new record on the leaderboard. Industry experts consider it one of the best-performing, fastest-generating, and most affordable image generation models available.

Z-Image Turbo supports deployment on consumer-grade graphics cards with 16GB of VRAM. In an H100 deployment environment, it takes only one second to generate images comparable to those produced by models with tens of billions of parameters. In terms of output quality, the model significantly enhances image realism, finely restoring details such as skin texture, hair strands, and fabric materials. It also improves bilingual text rendering capabilities in Chinese and English, maintaining clear text and natural layouts even in challenging scenarios like small fonts, complex typography, or poster designs.

Z-Image Turbo is capable of generating hyper-realistic images and bilingual Chinese-English posters.
